reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

Heartbroken by the passing of former New York Assembly Majority Leader Ron Canestrari.

Public service was a natural calling for Ron. A former colleague while we served together in the Assembly, and a longtime mayor of Cohoes, he was a titan who always fought on behalf of those he represented.

He believed wholeheartedly in the role of government to better people’s lives, and embodied that mission by leading with compassion, intelligence, and a relentless commitment to his community across his nearly 40 years of public service.

My thoughts are with his loved ones on this sad day. Ron’s spirit and heart will forever be remembered by myself and all those who had the honor of working alongside him.
